import sys
import random

def main():
    seed = int(sys.stdin.read().split()[0])
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    n = rng.randint(1, 6)
    m = rng.randint(1, 6)
    grid = [['#' if rng.random() < 0.25 else '.' for _ in range(m)] for _ in range(n)]
    r = rng.randrange(n)
    c = rng.randrange(m)
    grid[r][c] = '.'
    d = rng.choice('NESW')
    k = rng.randint(1, 20)
    cmds = ''.join(rng.choice('LRFFF') for _ in range(k))
    out = [f"{n} {m}"]
    for row in grid:
        out.append(''.join(row))
    out.append(f"{r} {c} {d}")
    out.append(str(k))
    out.append(cmds)
    print('\n'.join(out))

main()
